notes.title: DEMO available!
notes.content: [h3]Today we’re releasing the long-awaited DEMO version of LWT2: French confessions.[/h3][p][/p][p]This version of the game is a huge improvement in comparison to the original:[/p][list][*][p]we've upscaled the entire game from [b]1050x700[/b] to [b]3840x2160[/b] resolution—and it looks fantastic, both still images and animations[/p][/*][*][p]beyond the original content, you’ll get access to [b]brand-new scenes[/b], explicitly created for the [b]French Confessions[/b] version of the game. These images are rendered natively in high resolution, using modern shaders and lighting. The animations are more advanced—and, frankly, hotter than ever. Expect a blend of nostalgic charm and fresh intensity. (some of the you’ll have a chance to witness in this demo)[/p][/*][*][p]re-build in RENPY with unlimited save slots, option to roll back the decisions and improved performance[/p][/*][*][p]new interface hints, pointing current locations of characters[/p][/*][/list][p]So yes, it’s worth checking it out right now and adding French Confessions to your WISHLIST. We plan to release the full game later this year.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Let us know what you think about this demo version![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439508/bcab18f35af7bc7600f7c27560d1846666aed291.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439508/7ba2f9fecc9e09be74b27add0b2f7e00bb833629.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439508/51ba3bbee72b036d144098c8cc6592f25eca4da1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439508/84ada8d4e7cf6d9b5b31b28245cf3b4742d95f38.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439508/9bd81a7bebe147efa98841f5d6e2c480ebeee507.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439508/5403cd0766f33ac30694559357917fe34f25953a.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3444540/Living_with_Temptation_2_French_Confessions/"][/dynamiclink][/h3][h3]Curious about our plans for the full game release? Discover the tantalizing new scenes we have in store and get exclusive insights into our development progress![/h3][p][url="https://blog.lessonofpassion.com" style="button"]More info on our blog[/url][/p]
